sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 25

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 25:1
items.html: You already know that although the whole essence of the coupling by striking is in the screen in Malchut of the Rosh [head], nevertheless all the rejection and detaining in that screen is not at all in actuality, but only in the discernment of “potential.” Therefore it is impossible to discern there any matter of inner light and surrounding light at all, for light that is limited in a vessel is called inner light, and light that is not limited in a vessel is called surrounding light. And since there is as yet neither clothing here nor rejection from phase four, whence should a discernment of inner light and surrounding light arise here? The inner light and the surrounding light are therefore found joined together in the Peh [mouth], that is, in Malchut of the Rosh. But afterwards, when the clothing and the rejection that are in the Rosh went out from “potential” into “actuality” in the Guf [body], in the screen at the Tabur — for from the screen of the Tabur upward, that is, in the first nine Sefirot of the Guf, the lights clothed in vessels, and from the screen at the Tabur downward, that is, in Malchut of the Guf, the lights were rejected and did not clothe — then inner light and surrounding light were revealed here in actuality: the lights that came into the vessels from the Tabur upward are inner light, and the light that was fit to come from the Tabur downward and was rejected from there, because of the detaining of the screen at the Tabur, is surrounding light. Therefore a striking and a clash were made between the inner light — that is, the screen and the reflected light that clothes the direct light — and the surrounding light. For the surrounding light, which began to feel here the rejecting force in the coarseness of the screen, struck and clashed against it in order to refine it and to nullify the force of limit in it, so that it too might come into the internality of the Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 25:2
items.html: And know that here the surrounding light prevailed over the inner light, and that screen at the Tabur was refined and rose to the Peh [mouth], and there it was renewed until it brought out from itself downward a new expansion of Rosh, Toch and Sof, which is called the Partzuf AB of AK. Thus the surrounding light prevailed over the force of limitation in the screen, for it has now passed from it downward in a whole and complete Partzuf, which is called AB, as above. Understand this. (Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 6)
